card.name: Antipsychotic warning text: If, in, increased
card.fires_on: Small words inside the antipsychotic class warning text: sentence-initial "If" after the NMS treatment sentence, "in" before "nature" after causes of death, and "increased" before "risk of death".

modes.label: Sentence-opening If

modes.description: The word in closing a list of death causes, just before "nature".
